# Protective stops

## The answer
Write the exit line before entering and never move it further away. A stop is a plan, not a hope. ([[Notes/module-3.1/lesson-3.1.1|3.1.1]])

## How it works

### Placing the line
- Put the line beyond the last swing so noise does not trigger it. ([[Notes/module-3.1/lesson-3.1.1|3.1.1]])

### Moving the line
- Only tighten it. Moving it away turns a small loss into a large one. ([[Notes/module-3.1/lesson-3.1.1|3.1.1]])

## Where lessons disagree
- No disagreement found.

## Small-account and 0DTE notes
- A small account needs tighter lines because each loss is a larger share of equity.

## What the course doesn't cover
- Nothing on overnight gaps.
